premise: Four tiny friends each bring one tiny thing to a picnic, a drop of honey, a crumb, a seed and a cap for a cup, and Pinecone lies down flat to be the table: together it is a feast.
inspiration: Stone Soup (folk), turned tiny: no trickery needed, everyone brings a little and it adds up to plenty.
lesson: Small things shared add up to plenty.

en-US.title: The Tiny Picnic
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.3} {ladybug:float loop 0.3} It was a picnic day, and four tiny friends had one tiny problem. [sad] Everything they had was very small. Bee {bee:pulse} had one drop of honey. Ladybug {ladybug:pulse} had one crumb. Acorn {acorn:pulse} had one seed, and Pinecone {pinecone:pulse} had… well, Pinecone had herself. [curious] Is that a picnic? said Ladybug. It looked like four tiny things. Then Pinecone rolled over {pinecone:spin} and lay down flat. There, she said. A table. Bee put her honey drop in the middle. {bee:hop} Gold. Ladybug set her crumb beside it. {ladybug:hop} Acorn put down her seed, {acorn:hop} and took off her cap for a cup. Mouse {mouse:fade-in} peeped out to look. Squirrel {squirrel:fade-in} came to see too. [excited] One drop, one crumb, one seed, one cup, one table. Five things! That is a feast! {sfx:munch solo} And it was. Everybody had a taste, nobody left hungry, {bee:hearts} {ladybug:hearts} and there was even a lick of honey left for Mouse.

es-ES.title: El pícnic diminuto
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.3} {ladybug:float loop 0.3} Era día de pícnic, y cuatro amigas diminutas tenían un problema diminuto. [sad] Todo lo que tenían era muy pequeño. Abeja {bee:pulse} tenía una gota de miel. Mariquita {ladybug:pulse} tenía una miga. Bellota {acorn:pulse} tenía una semilla, y Piña {pinecone:pulse} tenía… bueno, Piña se tenía a sí misma. [curious] ¿Eso es un pícnic?, dijo Mariquita. Parecían cuatro cositas. Entonces Piña giró {pinecone:spin} y se tumbó bien plana. Ya está, dijo. Una mesa. Abeja puso su gota de miel en el medio. {bee:hop} Dorada. Mariquita dejó su miga al lado. {ladybug:hop} Bellota puso su semilla {acorn:hop} y se quitó el sombrerito para hacer una taza. Ratón {mouse:fade-in} asomó la nariz. Ardilla {squirrel:fade-in} vino a mirar. [excited] Una gota, una miga, una semilla, una taza, una mesa. ¡Cinco cosas! ¡Eso es un banquete! {sfx:munch solo} Y lo fue. Todos probaron, nadie se quedó con hambre, {bee:hearts} {ladybug:hearts} y hasta sobró un lametón de miel para Ratón.
